executedQuery:
_sourceCategory=formstack/prod/*
| json field=_raw "message"
| json field=_raw "context.submitActionId" as submitActionId
| json field=_raw "context.submissionId" as submissionId
| json field=_raw "context.formId" as formId
| json field=_raw "context.type" as type
| where %"message" = "SubmitAction {type} run for {submissionId}" AND submitActionId = 7557407

recordSchema._validationNote: To validate results, run the executedQuery directly in Sumo Logic
